title: Europe
text: Europe is a continent located entirely in the Northern Hemisphere and mostly in the Eastern Hemisphere. It is bordered by the Arctic Ocean to the north, the Atlantic Ocean to the west, the Mediterranean Sea to the south, and Asia to the east. Europe covers about 10.18 million square kilometers and has a population of over 745 million people, making it the third-most populous continent. The continent is the birthplace of Western civilization and has been central to world affairs for centuries. The European Union is a political and economic union of 27 member states primarily located in Europe.
